mapper.select: SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BDC.BRD_CODE AS BDC_BRD_CODE, MEM.MBR_CD, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_MOD_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BDC.BRD_CTGRY AS BDC_BRD_CTGRY, BDC.BRD_CMNT_YN AS BDC_BRD_CMNT_YN FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD LEFT JOIN BOARD_CARTEGORY BDC ON BD.BRD_CODE = BDC.BRD_CODE WHERE BD.BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BD.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_BRD_NO.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BOARD ( BRD_NO, BRD_CODE, MBR_CD, BRD_TITL_NM, BRD_CONT, BRD_PBLS_DTM, BRD_VW_CNT, BRD_MOD_DTM, BRD_DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{brdNo}, #{brdCode}, #{mbrCd}, #{brdTitlNm}, #{brdCont}, SYSDATE, 0, #{brdModDtm}, #{brdDelYn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_TITL_NM = #{brdTitlNm}, BRD_CONT = #{brdCont}, BRD_MOD_DTM = SYSDATE WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
